name: BrowserSkill
description: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
one_liner: Lets an AI assistant borrow your already-logged-in browser tab to do a task on a website, then hand it back, without you having to log in again or lose your place.
buyer: An ops or growth person who wants an AI agent to fill forms, check dashboards, or scrape data from sites that require a real logged-in session (no API available).
business_use_cases: A small e-commerce operator has their AI agent check supplier portals or marketplace dashboards daily and summarize changes, without re-authenticating each time.
An agency offers 'AI browser automation setup' for clients whose internal tools have no API, wiring up repetitive logged-in tasks (report downloads, status checks).
A recruiter automates checking job-board or ATS dashboards that require a logged-in session, freeing time for actual candidate outreach.

money_ideas.idea: Sell custom browser-automation workflows for specific no-API business tools
Offer a managed automation service that runs recurring logged-in-browser tasks for non-technical clients

steal_this: This weekend, build one automation for a common no-API SaaS dashboard (like a specific supplier portal) and sell it as a done-for-you service to small businesses using that tool.
